definitions.gloss: accrued payable; amount not yet paid
definitions.explanation: Money owed for something already received but outside the company's ordinary trade purchases — equipment, advertising, professional fees. Distinguished in bookkeeping from {買掛金|かいかけきん}.

examples.japanese: {未払金|みばらいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There is an unpaid amount outstanding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{広告費|こうこくひ}→広告費：30159_koukokuhi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未払金|みばらいきん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We recorded the advertising costs as an accrued payable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分割|ぶんかつ}→分割：11745_bunkatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{未払金|みばらいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: We bought the machine in installments, so the payable continues into next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{未払金|みばらいきん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{買掛金|かいかけきん}→買掛金：30204_kaikakekin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きちんと→きちんと：00222_kichinto⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦{整理|せいり}して→整理する：21729_seirisuru⟧おく。
examples.english: Before closing the books, we sort out accrued payables and trade payables properly.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet) + ⟦{払|はら}い→払い：18738_harai⟧ (payment) + {金|きん} (money). Outside accounting it is also used loosely for any bill still unpaid.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未払金|みばらいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to record an accrued payable
- {未払金|みばらいきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: for an unpaid amount to remain
- {未払金|みばらいきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{清算|せいさん}→清算：17092_seisan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to settle an unpaid amount

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{買掛金|かいかけきん}→買掛金：30204_kaikakekin⟧: accounts payable — used only for ordinary purchases of goods
- ⟦{未収金|みしゅうきん}→未収金：30183_mishuukin⟧: accrued receivable — the mirror image, money still to be received
- {未払|みばらい}い: unpaid — the adjectival form, as in {未払|みばらい}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧
